subject: Contract orchestration: tier shift & addendum redlines for Northstar expansion
messages:
From: Amelia Rhodes <amelia.rhodes@northstar.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@northstar.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + expansion: proposed addendum & order form (Northstar)

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Northstar is ready to move forward with the expansion we discussed: a tier shift that increases committed capacity ~3x and a 24‑month term. Attached is our suggested order form (NS-OrderForm-v3.pdf) and a short LOI for procurement.

Two quick asks so we can get procurement moving:
- Can Redwood confirm whether the MSA as currently written supports a 24‑month committed term w/ a 30‑day termination-for-cause window? (we may propose a limited change in Section 8)
- We expect security/retention paperwork — please point me to the evidence bundle or SOC2 report we should attach to the purchase packet.

We'd like to have redlines back to us by Oct 20 if possible to keep to procurement's timeline. Daniel (cc'ed) will be the procurement owner.

Attachments: NS-OrderForm-v3.pdf, NS-Procurement-Approval-LOI.pdf

Best,
Amelia Rhodes
Head of Cloud Partnerships — Northstar AI
amelia.rhodes@northstar.ai
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Rhodes <amelia.rhodes@northstar.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposed addendum & order form (Northstar)

Amelia — thanks for the docs and the clear timeline. I've looped in Karthik (pricing) and Lauren (legal).

Quick notes from my side before legal digs in:
- Pricing: Karthik, can you confirm whether we can hold the per-token uplift flat for the 24‑month term or if we need a step schedule?
- SLA / credits: procurement asked about credit caps on large expansions; if legal pushes for broader SLA language we may need to cap annual credits.
- Security bundle: Kimberly will drop the SOC2 link and data handling annex; copying her on this thread.

Amelia, we'll aim to deliver redlines and a pricing recap by Oct 20, but if legal has substantive asks it may be a day or two slip. I'll keep you posted.

Thanks —
Sergio
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Amelia Rhodes <amelia.rhodes@northstar.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposed addendum & order form (Northstar)

Sergio / Amelia —

Thanks — I reviewed the attached order form and flagged a small set of changes that we should propose back to Northstar. I attached a redline (Redlines_Northstar_2026.docx) with in‑line comments; key items: 

1) Term & Auto‑Renew: Northstar requests a 24‑month firm term. The MSA currently contains auto‑renew language that could extend the commitment beyond the requested 24 months. Recommend we propose explicit reciprocity: the order form should override the MSA auto‑renew for this contract term (counter language suggested in the doc).

2) Termination for convenience / early exit: procurement wants flexibility. We can accept a limited termination-for-convenience with a pro‑rated fee for remaining committed months (but propose a floor equal to 25% of remaining committed spend).

3) SLA credits cap: propose to cap annual SLA credits at 25% of fees in any 12‑month period (to mitigate large expansion exposure).

4) Data retention / evidence: Kimberly — please share SOC2 link and the draft data handling annex. We should not expose audit logs beyond the agreed retention.

If Northstar is comfortable with the proposed credit cap and the term override, we can mark up the order form and send back a single consolidated addendum. If not, we'll need a short MSA change which will take longer.

I can turn the tracked changes into a clean counter by EOD 10/16 if that timeline works.

- Lauren
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redlines_Northstar_2026.docx

Date: 2026-10-16T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposed addendum & order form (Northstar)

Lauren / Sergio —

Thanks for the quick review, Lauren — the proposed items are reasonable starting points. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- For the termination-for-convenience fee, procurement will push back on a high floor; can we present an alternative of a 60‑day notice + pro‑rata fee (no greater than 15% of remaining committed spend) and allow a one‑time early-exit in year two?
- SLA credits cap: procurement understands caps, but they'd like a clause for extraordinary outages to be considered outside the cap (we can agree a small carve‑out).

Daniel (procurement) will own commercial terms and timing. Daniel — are you able to review Redwood's counter and confirm a purchasing timeline?

Also attaching a short procurement LOI we use internally (NS-Procurement-Approval-LOI.pdf).

Best,
Amelia

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary and proposed path forward (to keep procurement on track):

1) Legal redlines: Lauren, please convert the tracked changes into a clean counter that: explicitly states the order form (NS-OrderForm-v3.pdf) overrides MSA auto‑renew for the 24‑month term; adds the alternative termination-for-convenience language (60‑day notice + pro‑rata fee capped at 15% of remaining committed spend) as a negotiable option; and retains an SLA credit cap but with carve‑out language for extraordinary outages. Target: counter to Amelia by EOD Oct 21.

2) Pricing: Karthik — provide a pricing recap (current per‑token rate, committed discount, and any step schedule if required) by Oct 21 so we can include a single commercial summary in the counter.

3) Billing annex & evidence: Kimberly — share SOC2 link, data handling annex, and a short one‑pager for procurement.

4) Ops milestone: propose signing order form + addendum by Oct 28; if we miss that, notify procurement immediately with an updated timeline.

I'll own external communications and follow up daily with Naples procurement. If anything looks risky, escalate to Sales Leadership.

Thanks —
Sergio
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
